name: Venomancer Rot Lich resets Serpent's Fang from direct hits but not from Mushroom explosions
contract: Rot Lich 92142 has a 20% chance (DBC ProcChance) on the Venomancer's direct damage to make the next Serpent's Fang free (706032) and reset its cooldown; its script rolls the chance, so spell_proc.Chance is 100.

Live combat logs (C:/CoA/SUB/old-logs, 2026-08-10 to 08-31) show 86 Rot Lich procs: Venom Bolt 32 of 168 hits and Serpent's Fang 21 of 167 hits, but 0 of 5593 Mushroom explosion hits, where 20% per hit would give about 1100.
The server casts every Mushroom explosion (504543, large 503925) from the Venomancer once per nearby enemy, so each hit reached the Rot Lich roll and Blightfang mushrooms multiplied the resets.

aura_proc_rate runs the aura's full proc decision 40000 times on a synthetic 1000-damage direct spell hit: Venom Bolt and Serpent's Fang stay inside 20 +/- 1.5 points, and both Mushroom explosions stay at 0.
